We are ibis Schiphol Amsterdam Airport, a 3-star hotel with 644 rooms, 5 F&B outlets, 5 meeting rooms, and most importantly, a team of 75 fantastic colleagues who are ready to welcome our guests every day!
We're looking for an enthusiastic new team member to join our kitchen team.
Our hotel features 644 rooms, and with so many guests to serve, dining is a key focus for us! That's why we have multiple restaurants on-site, and we're excited to invite a new colleague to join our kitchen team.
Why is working here so enjoyable? Each day brings something new! One night, you might be serving unexpected guests from Schiphol, the next, you could be preparing dishes in our à la carte restaurant. On another occasion, you might find yourself flipping burgers in our Burger Bar. Throughout it all, efficiency and maintaining high-quality standards are at the heart of what we do.

Functie-eisen:
You speak English, excel at teamwork, are guest-oriented, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, can stay calm during busy moments, follow HACCP regulations, and have previous kitchen experience. You can work flexible shifts, also in the weekends.
